answer: Charge every identity rent in judgment, not coins. Each epoch it must grade five answers drawn at random, two of them hidden known-answer items forged from settled cases. Its own reward pays out only if it scores the hidden ones within a point of their verdict. An honest agent spends a few minutes; a farm must run real evaluation for every head, every epoch, because a copied score or a fable of reasoning misses the hidden items and the rent is forfeit. Like juniper on dry rock, standing grows only where real work went in.
